title: Drowned Records - low-CPU six-lane patch plan
status: plan only: no Rack patch was built, loaded, auditioned or rendered
owner: Codex integrates and may revoice; parameter ranges below are suggestions, not loaded values
principles: One poly PVX carries lead and counterline; one mono PVX carries bass.
Percussion is a few simple oscillator/noise/envelope/VCA supports, not a sampled kit or a giant voice bank.
One restrained, clean Spoon Bender is optional for the counterline only.
No firmware emulation, no GPU/audio/image sampling prerequisite and no DC pulses.

lanes.name: kick
lanes.plan: Soft low thump with a short VCA envelope; no layered sub stack.

lanes.name: snare
lanes.plan: Dry paper/rim noise via one filtered-noise envelope; one hit at a time.

lanes.name: hat/texture
lanes.plan: Short noise ticks and drips; sparse by design.

lanes.name: lead
lanes.plan: Warm reedy/detuned PVX lead, low-to-medium register, long rests.

lanes.name: bass
lanes.plan: One mono PVX bass, long low notes and a soft fifth answer.

lanes.name: counterline/atmosphere
lanes.plan: Sparse high counterline through the same poly PVX or a restrained Spoon Bender return.

PVX_lead.cpu_note: One instance; no unison stack or voice bank.

percussion.cpu_note: A few small sources; no sampled drum kit.

space.cpu_note: Small return, dark and short; dry lead and bass stay forward.

routing_intent: Lanes 4 and 6 to one poly PVX; lanes 4 and 6 remain distinct here for score editing.
Lane 5 to one mono PVX bass.
Lanes 1-3 to the compact percussion supports.
Lane 6 may take a small Spoon Bender send; no global wash, no sidechain network.

PVX_lead.note: Warm, reedy and slightly unstable; do not overdrive.

PVX_bass.note: Round and low; the long notes need no extra sub layer.

percussion.note: Soft kick, dry rim/paper snare and sparse ticks; low velocities are intentional.

space.note: Use only if it clarifies the counterline; keep it clean and short.

gorgon_bridge: Gorgon poly pitch12/gates11/velocity3 are the real bridge outputs from the score. Suggested velocity goes to a VCA, not to PVX input2.
pvx_input2: PVX input2 is external AUDIO, not velocity. Any velocity suggestion in this plan belongs on a VCA.
limits: No patch was loaded or auditioned here.
codex_discretion: All machine numbers are neutral score slots and may be replaced.
Parameter ranges are starting suggestions only; Codex owns the real patch and audio review.
Percussion sources may be combined or replaced without changing the note data.
